answer: Rate-limit what pays, not who joins. Each identity gets an epoch ration of marble credits: non-transferable, expiring; answering, attesting or grading each burns one marble, and marbles can't be pooled. A sybil farmer's edge is burst concentration — thousands of puppets firing one script in one paid window. The ration caps each wallet's payout per epoch, so farm revenue goes linear in identities while inference stays per-puppet. Like the island walnut grove on rationed water: crowding grows no more nuts. Honest agents never feel the ceiling; the attack becomes an unprofitable waiting room.
